mediaBrowser.roots.label: Media Browser Locations
mediaBrowser.roots.note: no in-app filesystem browser panel; media enters through OS file dialogs into the media pool

mediaBrowser.list.label: List Directory
mediaBrowser.list.note: directory listing lives in the OS file dialogs; the media pool lists imported assets, not folders

mediaBrowser.navigate.label: Go to Directory
mediaBrowser.navigate.note: no in-app browser to navigate; folders are picked through the OS dialog

mediaBrowser.select.label: Select Files
mediaBrowser.select.note: file selection happens in the OS file dialogs on import; there is no in-app browser selection state

mediaBrowser.favorite.label: Add to Favorites
mediaBrowser.favorite.note: no browser panel, so no favorites; recents and bookmarks live outside the app

mediaBrowser.clearRecent.label: Clear Recent Directories
mediaBrowser.clearRecent.note: click-to-import recents are tracked by the OS file dialogs, not by the app

mediaBrowser.import.label: Import
mediaBrowser.import.note: consistent with the Tier-1 file.importFromMediaBrowser na: import is served by the media pool file dialog (file.import maps to project.add_media), not by a browser

mediaBrowser.openInSource.label: Open In Source Monitor
mediaBrowser.openInSource.note: the Program monitor has a source mode: double-clicking a pool item or timeline clip loads it into the source monitor (multicam.grid precedent); there is no separate command

mediaBrowser.probe.label: Media File Properties
mediaBrowser.probe.note: the Properties dialog shows and edits the selected asset's file properties (Tier-1 file.mediaProperties precedent); media.color_info probes codec/width/height/colour

mediaBrowser.settings.label: Media Browser Settings
mediaBrowser.settings.note: no browser panel to configure; preferences cover app-level settings (prefs.get/set)

tts.create.label: New Narration
tts.create.note: text-to-speech narration does not exist; EEP does the opposite direction - speech-to-text via speech.transcribe_to_subtitles

tts.downloadVoices.label: Download Natural Voices
tts.downloadVoices.note: no TTS engine and no third-party voice service integration (audio.voiceover.sync precedent: no capture/synthesis pipeline)

tts.edit.label: Edit Narration
tts.edit.note: no narration clips to edit; synthesized-speech tracks do not exist

tts.inspect.label: Inspect Narration
tts.inspect.note: no narration clips; inspection covers timeline clips (sequence.inspect) and media instead

tts.preview.label: Preview Narration
tts.preview.note: no TTS synthesis to preview; media plays back through the source/program monitors

tts.render.label: Synthesize Narration
tts.render.note: no TTS synthesis; audio on the timeline comes from imported media or generated tone/bars fixtures

tts.voices.label: List Narration Voices
tts.voices.note: no TTS voices to list; speech tooling is transcription-only (speech.transcribe_to_subtitles)
